decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The linked PR [ev-f0215a9bf24c] gives the cause: the NodePool readiness controller finds NodeClass updates by APIVersion, kind and name. "This NodePool" did not set the group, so if its NodeClass was not ready at the first reconciliation, the NodePool stayed unready and the test flaked. The PR and the commit change only one file, test/suites/scheduling/suite_test.go [ev-b889081063a3][ev-28bbf8a48e60][ev-ce3b0fd6bad0]. So the subject is the NodePool fixture in the E2E scheduling test suite, the change is test-only, and no shipped controller behaviour changes. An engineer can write the assertion from this: no customer environment is exposed, and nothing happens to an operator who does nothing.
